recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, chaotic caricature illustration of a multi-story Victorian house teeming with exaggerated characters engaged in various slapstick activities, set against a stark white background with bold, blocky title typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central architectural anchor supporting a swarm of peripheral action
High-contrast relationship between detailed, colorful illustration and negative white space
Vertical hierarchy from small metadata to large title to complex central image
coreInvariants: Exaggerated facial expressions and physical comedy
Primary red and yellow color accents within the illustration and type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The house and characters occupy the central 70% of the frame, tapering upward toward the roofline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central Victorian house structure acts as the skeleton for all character interactions.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement starting from the top title, spiraling down through the various character vignettes to the bottom-center car.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central cluster, focusing attention on the complexity of the drawing.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white/Cream background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red used for the primary title and key character clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for highlights, secondary text, and small props.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, watercolor-like washes for the house with high-saturation pops on characters and vehicles.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a comic-book primary palette

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with occasional overlapping characters
Inward-slanting vertical strokes on certain letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' and 'H' characters feature exaggeratedly thick stems
Terminals are blunt and slightly rounded
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, small-scale sans-serif for metadata to contrast the heavy, expressive display type.

preserve: The heavy weight of the display type
avoid: Drop shadows on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Shares the heavy weight and rounded corners of the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed pen-and-ink caricature of a crowded fraternity house party with dozens of characters in 1970s attire, using watercolor washes on a white background. Leave the top third of the image empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy, hand-drawn block-letter title in solid red in the top center, and small black sans-serif metadata at the very top and bottom corners.

verificationChecks: Is the title text heavy enough to balance the busy illustration?
Are the character expressions exaggerated and humorous?
Is the background pure white or light cream?
Does the house look like a hand-drawn architectural sketch?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the house siding
Style of the car at the bottom
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no characters are floating disconnected from the house or ground
Verify the red title is the most saturated element
Check that the linework is consistent across all characters
Confirm the composition tapers toward the top
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Subject: Architecture] + [Action: Crowded Caricatures] + [Style: Pen/Ink/Watercolor] + [Type: Heavy Red Block Lettering] + [Background: White Negative Space]
